problem.question: How can an ontology-grounded pipeline identify WHY a generated molecule is non-synthesizable and edit it into a synthesizable analogue while preserving pharmacophoric anchors, stereochemistry and binding interactions?

three_questions.Q3: what must not be touched during editing

crux.lesson: agents do engineering but fail at evidence sufficiency

figures.title: Ontology grounding raises hard-OK rate over similarity and random baselines
figures.claim_supported: Ontology-grounded selection attains hardOK 0.875 versus 0.5 for both the similarity and random baselines.
figures.non_decorative_justification: Encodes the primary quantitative comparison; removing it removes the central evidence for the ontology advantage.
caveats: The token '48api' and its denominator are not defined in CONTEXT.
No error bars / confidence intervals are provided in CONTEXT.

figures.title: End-to-end edit validity by method
figures.claim_supported: Ontology and ontology+LoRA edits reach validity 1.0 versus 0.5 for SynCraft.
figures.non_decorative_justification: Quantifies the end-to-end editing claim (Q of the pipeline: edit into a synthesizable analogue) against the closest published baseline (SynCraft).
caveats: end2edit_validity.source is null in CONTEXT — provenance for these numbers is missing.
No error bars / CI provided.

figures.title: Anchor violation rate by method (pharmacophore / stereocentre preservation)
figures.claim_supported: Ontology-based editing shows 0.0 anchor violation versus 0.125 for SynCraft, evidencing preservation of the anchors that must not be touched (Q3).
figures.non_decorative_justification: Directly answers sub-question Q3 ('what must not be touched during editing') with a measured quantity.
caveats: anchor_violation.source is null in CONTEXT — provenance missing.
0.0 values may reflect small sample size; no n or CI provided.

figures.title: Reasoner inference census grounding the symbolic claims
figures.type: horizontal bar chart of counts (log-scale x recommended given range 2-363); provenance annotation 'owlrl 10400->23113 triples'
figures.claim_supported: The ontology materially defines ValidatedEditSequence (78), StereocenterPreservingReaction (2) and the StereocenterAnchor contract (320), and asserts hasRequiredOperation SET_CHIRAL (115) — grounding symbolic claims SYM1-SYM4 from the previous phase.
figures.non_decorative_justification: Provides the machine-checkable evidence that the pipeline's constructs exist and fire, which is the substrate for every downstream numerical claim.
caveats: Counts are assertion/instance counts, not effect sizes.
owlrl expansion 10400->23113 triples is shown only as a provenance annotation, not as a data series.

figures.title: Win/loss record and exact sign-test significance
figures.type: two-panel figure: (a) win-loss stacked bars; (b) p-value annotation panel
figures.claim_supported: Ontology wins all paired comparisons (6 wins / 0 losses, p=0.0156; end2end 7 wins / 0 losses, p=0.0078) under an exact sign test.
figures.non_decorative_justification: Supplies the statistical-significance layer that upgrades the raw rates in FIG1-FIG3 from descriptive to inferential.
caveats: The specific paired items behind '6 wins' and '7 wins' are not enumerated in CONTEXT.
Sign-test n is small (6 and 7).

figures.non_decorative_justification: Included only if a reproducibility/scale claim is made; otherwise omit to honor the no-decorative-figures rule.

design_notes: All plotted numbers are restated verbatim from CONTEXT; no arithmetic beyond restating the given fractions/counts is performed.
Suggested layout: combine FIG1/FIG2/FIG3 as panels (a)/(b)/(c) of a single 'main results' figure; FIG5 can be an inset or panel (d).
Consistent color convention: baselines (similarity, random, syncraft) in neutral grey; ontology and ontology_lora highlighted.
FIG4 x-axis should be log-scaled because counts span 2 to 363.
FIG6 arrows must be visually distinguished as author-defined mapping (e.g., dashed) to avoid implying the mapping is asserted by the ontology.
FIG7 should be a table if included; do not plot heterogeneous units on a shared axis.
